main_measure.name: mean short-direction 12-bar excess return over coin drift, Sunday 23:00 signals (forecast <= -2)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with slope on forecast size > 0; reject: t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: least-squares slope of short-direction excess return on |forecast|

decided_by: Mean short-direction excess return is positive with t >= 2 and the slope on the forecast's size is above 0.
reading: Situation bars are those starting Sunday 23:00 UTC with a negative raw weekend_fall value (else negative 48-bar return) and a recomputed 48/120-bar volume ratio above 1 (regime 'trending' where it cannot be recomputed); the excess is -(r12 - coin drift), drift being the coin's mean 12-bar return on the 0,12,24,... grid of all its windows; cases are deduplicated to the first per coin and ISO week, those without 12 later bars in the window are dropped, and the slope is on |forecast|.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
